description: TfL publishes a bus-station location layer. The provider directs users to the dataset-last-updated attribute for currency. Bus stations are represented separately from the bus-stop, shelter and stand inventories in the same collection. The source does not establish passenger volumes, station capacities or condition information, so those would require additional data before detailed operational simulation. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
